::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 1st 1877  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne,Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS University of Iowa; MsL/Y56ty
:::

My dear [Mr Tyrwhitt](people/person_1428.qmd), 

There is a chapter on [Basilica](other_books/otherbook_888.qmd) in the printer’s hands just now. I ought to have sent it up for October and I don’t know how I missed laying my hands on it when I was packing up the MS. I ought to have mentioned it when you wrote to me, and now I am terribly afraid  I have given you ‘double double toil and trouble’. When the proofs come you will see what amount of repetition there is. Had I not better return you the new chapter to look at with  it, I am greatly concerned at any blundering of mine having given you additional troubles.[^1]

Your study of your son reminds me of [my Mother](people/person_1606.qmd) saying it was a curious sensation when she began not to know where all my ideas came from

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The Rev. Richard St. John Tyrwhitt (1827-1895), a follower of Ruskin and art criti, contributed a series of articles on  'The Basilica' to  *MP*, beginning in ns 25 (January 1878) 1-14 and running until ns 30 (July 1880) 1-18.
